verdict.rationale: Daytona's docs show agent-driven sandbox provisioning and code execution end to end. The Python SDK snippet creates a sandbox and returns an exec response the agent can read. An official MCP server lets agents such as Claude, Cursor and Windsurf drive sandboxes programmatically, and an agent skill covers creating and running sandboxes. Lifecycle management through the CLI and SDKs, plus 'shut them down just as fast', covers teardown, backed by a published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit documented delete/teardown call or example, and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully autonomous agent loop.
